[RDSC.4.5] Atom bodies are stored uncompressed
(`COMPRESSION_NONE`), so the runtime links no compression
library and body bytes are stable across platforms and
toolchains. `SchemaDef` ([RDSC.5.8]) and `DsSource` ([RDSC.14.2]) bodies are
`COMPRESSION_NONE` like every other. The `Compression` value
`2` is reserved and must never be reused ([STYL.2.8.7]).
